snippet.title: Godzone 6 Official Teaser Trailer - A new game from the Wild Bastards and Void Bastards team.
snippet.description:
Welcome to the first first-person mutator, coming in something less than 10,000 years, brought to you by the creators of Void Bastards and Wild Bastards (and Card Hunter).


Godzone 6 delivers a unique blend of deep immersive sim gameplay with near infinite combinations of bizarre lineages and mutations. Stealth, melee, ranged, hacking, environmental controls, pickpocketing, ancient relics, looting, psychic powers, flying, crawling, grappling, jumping, it's all there and ready to support whatever style of gameplay you want to pursue.


Godzone 6 - "Be all you probably shouldn't be"

Official website with Forum:
http://godzone6.com/
Steam store page, Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850440/Godzone_6/
